_doc: Accepted findings: rule -> {key: reason}. Each entry is debt with a reason, not a pass. Remove an entry when the finding is fixed (check --all lists stale ones).

wording-taiwan.front/classic/index.html: Upstream AI-news-radar page (fork origin), simplified Chinese; not part of the TW radar UI. Remove the page or convert it, then drop this entry.
wording-taiwan.front/legacy/index.html: Same upstream page kept as a legacy redirect target; convert or delete.

no-pg-cron.db/supabase/manual/radar_ingest_schedule: Manual, never-applied rollback reference from the pg_cron era (#7). Mac launchd owns scheduling; delete once the cloud fallback is retired.

jobs-conf.nolock-writer:broker-data: Intentional: broker files are read only by broker-data's own publish step, so it skips the shared lock to avoid blocking the hourly radar (see jobs.conf comment).

table-has-reader.radar.event_outcome: BREAKPOINT (M014): per-event backtest outcomes; same fix as radar.path_backtest.
table-has-reader.radar.event_impact: Impact rows of radar.event; same decision as radar.event (read or stop writing).
table-has-reader.radar.market_snapshot: Pre-market market snapshot dual-write (#10); page reads pm_pulse. Decide: read or drop.

dataset-has-caller.api/v1/tracking-candidates: External consumer (NexusDashboard, #6), authenticated; not meant for the radar front.
